questions.q: Where does NCR Voyix sit in IO Resource's brand mix?
questions.e: NCR Voyix is IOR's #1 brand by revenue at roughly 24%.

questions.q: What should a rep do before quoting NCR?
o: Coordinate with Conn — the NCR module is parked and Conn-owned
questions.e: NCR is parked and maintained by Conn; coordinate with him before quoting.

questions.q: What does NCR Voyix primarily supply?
o: POS terminals and self-checkout hardware for retail, hospitality and grocery
questions.e: NCR Voyix supplies POS terminals and self-checkout (SCO) hardware for retail, hospitality and grocery.
